notes.title: Controller and Mac Update
notes.notes:
Game controllers now work much more reliably
 Issues with Apple silicon Macs should be resolved

notes.title: Bug fix update 1.5.0.2
notes.notes: We fixed a rarely encountered crash bug: If you were playing a "hard" bonus level and you got eaten at the exact same time that you ate something else, the game could crash. It's fixed now.
